newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Dhaka stocks close 3.22 pct down on kerb protests.
newsitem.headline: Dhaka stocks close 3.22 pct down on kerb protests.

text.p: Agitation by panicky kerb traders disrupted trading on the Dhaka Stock Exchange (DSE) on Monday, and brokers said this sent stocks tumbling.

The DSE benchmark index ended 61.26 points or 3.22 percent lower at 1,839.37. Turnover dwindled to 4.7 million taka, the lowest in recent months, from Sunday's 43.4 million. Most traders were unable to get into the exchange because of the demonstration outside the building.
Of 59 issues traded, 57 ended lower and just two gained. Kerb market traders are demanding immediate government intervention to bolster confidence in the market.
